explicacoes.explicacao: +100% é vs 4T25 (2.906→5.810); vs 1T25 é +51%. Brent subiu 27% (63,7→81,1 US$/b), não 23%. Lucro ajustado subiu só 41% (3,8→5,4 bi); o resto vem da inversão dos itens de ajuste: +0,4 bi no 1T26 (+1,4 bi efeito estoque/valor justo, −0,9 bi não recorrentes) vs −0,9 bi no 4T25 (−0,7 bi impairments eólica offshore, −0,2 bi estoque).
explicacoes.trecho: Net income (TotalEnergies share) 1Q26 5.8 / 4Q25 2.9, +100% vs 4Q25; Brent 81.1 vs 63.7, +27% vs 4Q25; adjustment items: $1.4 billion of inventory valuation and fair value effects, ($0.9) billion of non-recurring items

explicacoes.explicacao: Base de comparação deprimida por impairments.
explicacoes.trecho: Adjustment items to net income totaled -$0.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025, consisting mainly of: -$0.7 billion in impairments, in particular for the offshore wind activity within the Integrated Power segment, -$0.2 billion from inventory valuation effects.

explicacoes.explicacao: FCF alto (6.318) por liberação de capital de giro de +3.867 (DFC).
explicacoes.trecho: Operating cash flow amounted to $10,471 million in the fourth quarter of 2025, corresponding to cash flow from operations excluding working capital (CFFO) of $7,168 million and a $3.8 billion improvement in working capital.

explicacoes.explicacao: FCF negativo (−1.260) por consumo de capital de giro de −6.968 na DFC; o release fala em +5,1 bi de capital de giro, metade sazonal e metade efeito da alta de preços nos estoques. Padrão sazonal se repete no 1T25 (−4.232).
explicacoes.trecho: cash flow growth driven by higher energy prices partly offset a $5.1 billion increase in working capital, half of it reflecting business seasonality and half of it linked to the impact of higher hydrocarbon prices

explicacoes.explicacao: FCF volta a 6.626: CFFO de 9,8 bi e liberação de capital de giro (+1.663 na DFC; ~1,2 bi no conceito da empresa) com a queda de preços no fim do trimestre.
explicacoes.trecho: Cash flow from operating activities was $10,858 million in the second quarter of 2026, for a cash flow from operations excluding working capital (CFFO) of $9,804 million, taking into account the $1.2 billion decrease in working capital, mainly reflecting the impact of the decrease in hydrocarbon prices at the end of the quarter, particularly on inventories.

explicacoes.explicacao: FCF negativo por capital de giro.
explicacoes.trecho: 2025 first quarter cash flow from operating activities was $2,563 million versus CFFO of $6,992 million, and was impacted by increased working capital of $4.4 billion.

explicacoes.explicacao: Yahoo diverge em 2T25–2T26 (+1,6 a +4,1 bi acima do primário: 36.614 vs 34.834; 35.073 vs 33.380; 32.907 vs 28.782; 34.142 vs 31.540; 30.991 vs 28.614). explicacoes.explicacao: Yahoo (9.028; 10.398; 8.963; 14.304; 12.543) não bate nem com o padronizado nem com o adj. EBITDA. O padronizado IFRS inclui efeitos de estoque e itens não recorrentes (ex.: 1T26 13.585 > adj. 12.552 pelo efeito estoque positivo; 2T26 12.371 < adj. 13.179).
